overall_worst.defect: The quick start never shows its success states. The "Sign in to Vendure" screen and the synced order in the Vendure Dashboard are described only in words, so a developer cannot tell at a glance whether their till is working

overall_worst.fix: Add two screenshots at the same framed width as the hero: the "Sign in to Vendure" form at step 8, and the POS order in the Vendure Dashboard order list at "Check it worked" (and on connect-a-till), each with a one-line caption aligned to the body text edge
